tools.name: simulate_pi
tools.description: Estimate pi with seeded Monte Carlo and a 95% Wilson interval; up to 5 million samples. CPU or optional CUDA. Other direct scientific engines run on CPU.

tools.name: optimize_tasks
tools.description: Exactly maximize value for up to 32 independent, indivisible tasks within an integer-minute budget. Each task is selected at most once; no prerequisites or shared resources.

tools.name: verify_shadows
tools.description: Check measured shadows using NOAA solar position, a ground-plane homography from 4–16 controls and Monte Carlo uncertainty. Returns conditional consistency, never image authenticity.

tools.name: check_ephemeris
tools.description: Check a claimed Sun (soleil) or Moon (lune) position for UTC time/location using NOAA/Meeus approximations and lunar parallax. Returns model-conditional angular consistency and lunar phase.

tools.name: audit_statistics
tools.description: Apply necessary GRIM/GRIMMER checks to rounded means and sample deviations of bounded integer observations. Passing does not prove a dataset exists; inconsistency does not establish fraud.

tools.name: analyze_kinematics
tools.description: Convert angular speed and candidate distances to minimum transverse speeds; check a claimed speed-distance pair. Distance hypotheses are supplied, not measured; no object-origin conclusion.

tools.name: check_shadow_track
tools.description: Compare 4–120 measured minute/azimuth pairs with solar motion: residuals, slope, direction and time-lapse speed. Supply measurements, not video. Results are model-conditional consistency findings.

tools.name: solve_equilibrium
tools.description: Solve Kuhn poker with CFR+ self-play, measure exploitability with pure best responses and compare the game value with -1/18. Illustrative game theory, not gambling advice.

tools.name: analyze_chess_game
tools.description: Compare 4–40 supplied FEN positions and played SAN/UCI moves with Stockfish: first-choice agreement and centipawn loss. Entire analysis has a 25-second deadline; no cheating verdict.

tools.name: screen_wash_trading
tools.description: Screen a supplied trade series for repeated volume at nearly equal prices within a declared time window. Return recycled-volume ratio and cycles; a pattern does not prove wash trading.

tools.name: simulate_plan
tools.description: Estimate deadline success, mean duration and empirical p95 for up to 32 integer-minute tasks under independent bounded uniform duration variations. Seeded CPU sampling; not a real-world forecast guarantee.

tools.name: route_optimizer
tools.description: Order 2–256 points from index 0 using planar or spherical kilometre distances. Exact only after completed Held–Karp search (at most 13 points); otherwise bounded heuristics. Returns every leg and stop reason. No roads or traffic.

tools.name: forge_route_policy
tools.description: Train route-score ASTs on 1–8 supplied cases: at most 64 attempts and 31 nodes; stop between trials after 25s. Select converged candidates using training quality plus logical-fuel cost, a work proxy rather than CPU time. No held-out validation, arbitrary code or automatic promotion.

tools.name: run_route_policy
tools.description: Execute a supplied bounded score AST on 2–128 Euclidean-km points with depot 0 and 2-opt. Validates the closed tour; exact=false. No retraining, external effects or promotion. Hashes identify programs, not independent validation.

tools.name: plan_golden_hour
tools.description: Compute geometric golden [-4,+6°] and blue [-6,-4°] windows for one UTC day, 1900–2100. Sunrise at -0.833° is a separate convention. No refraction, terrain or weather. Numerical tolerance is not astronomical accuracy; oracle validation covers reference dates only. Shared solar models are not indepen

tools.name: triangulate_tracks
tools.description: Fit position/velocity from 2–4 supplied azimuth/elevation tracks using constant velocity in spherical ECEF and declared angular noise/clocks. Reports fit status and conditional local uncertainty; no object identification or calibrated accuracy.

tools.name: plan_observation
tools.description: Fit original tracks, then rank 1–64 supplied future series by local-linear uncertainty and declared cost. Assumes constant velocity, independent new errors and exact stations/clocks. Candidate angles and client baselines are forbidden. Prediction is not an acquired measurement or visibility proof.

tools.name: assimilate_observation
tools.description: Refit original tracks plus one supplied new angular series, each counted once; compute the baseline natively. Declare synthetic/measured origin (unverified). Conditional uncertainty may worsen; forecast angles are not acquired evidence.

tools.name: stress_test_observation
tools.description: Refit 1–32 declared hypothetical angular/clock perturbations to challenge reconstruction stability. Explicit hypothetical acknowledgement required. Non-convergence is inconclusive; none_found covers examined cases only. No new observations.

tools.name: improve_schedule
tools.description: Compare up to 32 declared deadline/optional-task changes under independent-uniform durations; preserve required tasks. Search bounds select one finalist for separately seeded confirmation, without retries. Conditional on the model, not delivery reliability.

tools.name: list_capabilities
tools.description: Read native contracts, themes, units, assumptions, backends and approved composition families; optional exact theme filter. tools/list discovers direct MCP tools; list_composition_capabilities adds planner bindings.

tools.name: plan_mission
tools.description: Preview robust scheduling without running engines: validate assumptions/permissions and return up to three candidate budgets (nominal, 10% reserve, 20% reserve), compute limits or blockers. No arbitrary tools or external code.

tools.name: build_robust_plan
tools.description: Compare up to three task selections; choose highest examined value meeting the target under simultaneous 95% sampling bounds or an exact bound. Independent-uniform durations; can return inconclusive/blocked. Streams native events.

tools.name: list_composition_capabilities
tools.description: Read implemented versioned contracts, native capabilities, approved adapters and planning examples. Unsupported unit/model facts expose missing adapters. No engines run; direct tools remain independently callable.

tools.name: compose_capabilities
tools.description: Plan from declared available/goal contracts within tool, locality and search bounds. Returns dependencies, blockers and existing-tool bindings. Cost counts graph steps, not speed, price or quality. Runs no engines; execution validates arguments.

tools.name: execute_composition
tools.description: Run approved task-selection/route-to-duration risk chains only. Supply engine inputs and explicit uncertainty; route speed is 1–150 km/h. Returns native receipts and 95% sampling bounds. Completed means assessed, not safe. Other paths use advertised bindings.

tools.name: network_status
tools.description: Read contributor availability, offered CPU/GPU resources and verified throughput by workload. Hardware is self-reported; per-GPU VRAM is not pooled. Mixed-workload samples do not measure comparative speed.

tools.name: submit_network_job
tools.description: Queue fixed public synthetic pi (CPU/CUDA) or one of three discrete schedule scenarios (CPU only). No private data/custom code. Returns a ticket; poll get_network_job. Coordinator recomputes every accepted shard; no net speedup claim. Jobs may expire.

tools.name: get_network_job
tools.description: Read a public contributor ticket/progress and verified pi or discrete synthetic schedule result. Schedule results include fixed-sample Wilson95 bounds. Worker/verification/wall times are separate; model probabilities are not delivery guarantees.

tools.name: check_arithmetic
tools.description: Check an explicit arithmetic claim. Checked i128 rationals give exact verdicts when expression, claim and tolerances are representable. Unsupported functions or overflow return an estimate with an undetermined verdict. Includes a versioned integrity digest; no checks of units or model meaning.

tools.name: compute_orbit
tools.description: Compute an ideal two-body Keplerian orbit around one solar mass. Time starts at periapsis; distances use AU and time uses days. This model is not a real celestial ephemeris.

tools.name: hear_the_shape
tools.description: Compute 1–12 ideal fixed/free membrane modes for a simple polygon in metres using bounded P1 finite elements. Return upper bounds, extrapolated estimates and optional frequencies/shapes. Finite spectral agreement does not prove isospectrality; no damping. CPU, direct-only; no planner binding.

tools.name: kepler_stability
tools.description: Survey up to 512 initial orbits in a planar circular Sun–Jupiter model; at most 4 million reserved CPU steps. Return finite-window sensitivity, actual durations, sampled Jacobi drift and explicit stops. Bands do not prove chaos or stability; radial overlap is not an encounter. Direct-only.

tools.name: propagate_uncertainty
tools.description: Check dimensions, then compare first-order GUM with seeded fixed-sample Monte Carlo for an explicit model of 1–16 inputs. Return uncertainty budgets, coverage intervals and convergence/linearization findings. Conditional on supplied distributions; no affine units. CPU, direct-only; no planner bindin

tools.name: verify_claim
tools.description: Verify a structured arithmetic, shadow, ephemeris, statistics or route claim with a bounded native engine. Returns a model-scoped verdict and portable Ed25519 server receipt; never truth, authenticity or fraud certification. Route claims explicitly distinguish optimality from a supplied tour total.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_network_job · Private data: submit_network_job · Public sink: submit_network_job · Destructive: simulate_pi, run_route_policy, list_composition_capabilities, execute_composition.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_network_job · Private data: submit_network_job · Public sink: submit_network_job · Destructive: simulate_pi, run_route_policy, list_composition_capabilities, execute_composition

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
